SEARCH
Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc

Schnittstelle NpcManager

public interface NpcManager
The registry of every NPC on the server, and the entry point for creating and deleting them.

Obtained from BetterNPCsApi.npcManager().

Threading

Lookups are safe from any thread and return handles that are not. Everything that changes the registry — creating, deleting, loading — must be called on the main server thread.

Seit:
1.0.0

  • Methodendetails

    • create

      Npc create(String name, NpcType type, NpcPosition position)
      Creates an NPC and registers it.

      The NPC starts in NpcState.CREATED and is not rendered until Npc.spawn() is called. It is written to storage with the next save cycle.

      Fires NpcCreateEvent before anything is registered; cancelling it makes this method throw, because there is no sensible NPC to return.

      Parameter:
      name - the NPC's name, unique among NPCs
      type - what the NPC is rendered as
      position - where the NPC stands
      Gibt zurück:
      the new NPC
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if any argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if name is blank or already taken
      IllegalStateException - if a listener cancelled the creation

    • create

      Npc create(NpcSnapshot snapshot)
      Creates an NPC from a snapshot, keeping its unique id.

      Used by migrations and by anything restoring a backup, where the id has to be preserved so that external references to the NPC keep resolving.

      Parameter:
      snapshot - the snapshot to create from
      Gibt zurück:
      the new NPC
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if snapshot is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the snapshot's name or unique id is already taken
      IllegalStateException - if a listener cancelled the creation

    • targetedBy

      Optional<Npc> targetedBy(org.bukkit.entity.Player player, double maxRange)
      Returns the NPC a player is looking at, if any is within reach.

      What /npc commands use when no name is given, so that an administrator can point at an NPC instead of remembering what it is called.

      Parameter:
      player - the player whose line of sight to trace
      maxRange - the furthest distance in blocks to consider
      Gibt zurück:
      the NPC, or empty if the player is not looking at one
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if player is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if maxRange is not positive

    • delete

      CompletableFuture<Boolean> delete(Npc npc)
      Deletes an NPC.

      Despawns it, removes it from the registry, invalidates its handle and deletes it from storage. Fires NpcDeleteEvent first, which may cancel the deletion.

      Parameter:
      npc - the NPC to delete
      Gibt zurück:
      a future completing with true once the NPC has been deleted from storage, or with false if a listener cancelled the deletion
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if npc is null
      IllegalStateException - if the NPC has already been removed

    • delete

      CompletableFuture<Boolean> delete(String name)

      Gibt zurück:
      a future completing with true once the NPC has been deleted, or with false if no NPC has that name or a listener cancelled the deletion
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if name is null

    • reload

      CompletableFuture<Integer> reload()
      Discards the in-memory registry and loads it again from storage.

      Unsaved changes are written first, so nothing is lost. Every existing Npc handle is invalidated — including ones extensions are holding — so extensions should look their NPCs up again after NpcLoadEvent.

      Gibt zurück:
      a future completing with the number of NPCs loaded
